name: Kim Loong Resources Berhad
summary: Kim Loong Resources Berhad, an investment holding company, engages in the cultivation of oil palm in Malaysia. The company operates through two segments, Plantation and Milling. It processes and markets oil palm fresh fruit bunches, palm kernel shells, and oil palm products; processes oil palm fibre; and biogas and power generation businesses. The company also extracts residual oil from wet palm fiber; converts palm fiber; and provides transportation services. Kim Loong Resources Berhad was incorporated in 1975 and is based in Johor, Malaysia. Kim Loong Resources Berhad is a subsidiary of Sharikat Kim Loong Sendirian Berhad.
